source.check: votes from the News-Letter's ward results (INA OCR); * = retiring member as printed; where the OCR of a vote is garbled the figure used is the one that agrees with both the printed valid votes and the printed majority; unopposed returns from the News-Letter of 7 January 1927

note: Annual election of one councillor in each of the 15 wards of Belfast Corporation (the member retiring in rotation), nominations 5 January, poll Saturday 15 January 1927. Seven retiring members were returned unopposed after Zimri Stewart withdrew in St Anne's, and eight wards were contested (Belfast News-Letter, 6, 7 and 17 January 1927). Socialist gain by six votes after the papers were examined again; Browne had won the seat as an Independent Unionist in 1924.
